title: Trinetra Comics website is live
text: The official online home of the Trinetra Comics universe is now live.

title: Phase 1 website update
text: Search, sharing tools, hero navigation and the expanding franchise structure have been added.

title: The Trinetra hero roster expands
text: Dedicated profile pages are being prepared for the heroes of the growing Trinetra Universe.

title: Brahmansh — The Star Hunter
text: Brahmansh Issue #1 remains the first featured story on the Trinetra Comics website.
